info.description: Experimental independent fingerprint service. No official Music Assistant affiliation. Gateway mode requires BOTH personal and application credentials. Gateway errors may use a different body than backend errors. Recognition PCM is transient; no downloading or audio export is provided.
info.title: Audio Fingerprint HTTP API

get.description: Requires read access. Queue or read cached album artwork for a published reference. The worker resolves the album through MusicBrainz and Cover Art Archive. Poll pending results no more than once every three seconds. Missing artwork and transient unavailability do not affect recognition.

post.description: Requires read access. Raw interleaved little-endian float32 PCM, normalized finite samples in [-1,1], 3-15 seconds, 8000-192000 Hz, 1-2 channels. No WAV/container or multipart data. Byte limit is 15 * sample_rate * channels * 4. match is null unless matched. Candidate fractions are not probabilities.

post.description: Requires read access. Transient precomputed landmarks for a 3–15 second capture normalized to 44,100 Hz mono. Offsets are relative to the capture, in 2,048-sample hops. At most 10,000 distinct pairs and 512,000 request bytes. Shares the PCM endpoint's backend request budget, concurrency slots and acceptance rules. Does not store or publish submitted landmarks.
